subject.title: fix(line): prevent silent webhook loss after acknowledgment

question: Should this protected maintainer-context PR receive an explicit proof override, or must it add inspectable real LINE transport proof before merge?
rationale: The implementation has substantial focused validation, but repository policy treats after-fix real behavior proof as a merge gate and automation cannot recreate the contributor’s LINE environment.

options.title: Require LINE proof
options.body: Request redacted runtime logs, terminal output, or a recording covering receipt, restart recovery, reply delivery, and redelivery on the exact head.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused scenario evidence in place of a real LINE artifact.

recommendation.title: Require LINE proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted runtime logs, terminal output, or a recording covering receipt, restart recovery, reply delivery, and redelivery on the exact head.
